name: 시나리오 1 합성(composed)
source: Rows are what happens in the home: where the resident is (fridge, table, sofa), device events, phone arrivals and when the viewer leaves. Every photo row has its capture time and the VLM answer lag (1.5-2.0 s; measured average nano 1.6 s, mini 1.8 s) at the system's VLM interval. The replay builds each photo from the phone camera at that moment (the spot the phone stands at, facing that spot's look_at, landscape 40 deg vertical view, 1.15 m, 10 deg down): only what is inside that view is in the photo. Frame references copy only the recorded VLM cup and drinking observations. The phone reacts after 1.5 s and follows the issued doorways and waypoints at up to 0.8 m/s. The living-room standby position is by the wall after the turn, facing both the TV and the sofa. Appliance recognition is composed from camera visibility and appliance state. A person is counted when the torso is in view and located only when the feet are in view. A held cup is in front of the camera. PAM answers after the first watching answer.
